{{Removed|date = 10th of February 2024}} {{Unreleased|planned = was never properly released and was only left unused in-game}} {{UnitInfobox |title1 = Jeep |image-static = Jeep.png |image-dynamic = JeepDynamic.png |pseudoxd = true |type = Vehicle |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]50 |damage_type = Single
Collison |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]30 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.15 |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]3 |speed = 6 |hidden = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Jeep''' was an unreleased unit that would have been spawned by the Jeep item. As the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] item system (later to become [[consumables]]) was never properly finished, the '''Jeep''' was left unused. The '''Jeep''' had a mounted gun which it would attack enemies with. As the item it would spawn from could only be used up to five times per match, a player could only spawn five '''Jeeps''' per match. If the player did not have any Jeep items, they could pay {{Coins|150}} to purchase one in the match. However, as this system was never properly released, the only method of summoning it was admin commands. ==Appearance== The '''Jeep''' was a green jeep driven by a driver with tan skin, white and black goggles, and black torso and legs. It had four reinforced wheels and barbed wire on the front. On its back, there was a gunner with tan skin, green shirt and pants, and black shoes. It fired at enemies with a mounted machine gun. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} JeepIcon.png|'''Jeep''' on the Jeep item icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Jeep''' originally had a different model than the one which was added in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], which could be seen on the Jeep item icon. **The main difference is the characters in the jeep, as both the driver and the gunner have yellow skin there. They also both have the exact same models, while the in-game model has them use two separate designs. ==Update History== *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Jeep''' added. *'''10 February 2024''' - [[v1.13.0]] **'''Jeep''' removed. {{TowerNavBox}}
